$comment: Pinned mpv builds bundled into the Windows and macOS packages (plan §4.4 Binaries); read by scripts/fetch-mpv.mjs.
All three are mpv-player's own first-party GitHub CI builds, attached to the upstream v0.41.0 release: mpv-player
publishes an official build for every platform we bundle, so no third-party build is used. mpv.io/installation
describes these CI builds as 'intended mainly for testing and may be missing certain features'.
sha256 was computed from a download on 2026-10-19 and matches the digest GitHub reports for each asset.
Linux is not listed on purpose: deb/rpm/AppImage/pacman use the system mpv (>= 0.39) or Flatpak io.mpv.Mpv.
To update: change version/url/sha256/size, run `node scripts/fetch-mpv.mjs --platform all --force`, and update

win-x64.publisher: mpv-player: first-party GitHub CI build attached to the v0.41.0 release
win-x64.minOs: Windows 10 (static CRT; imports only system DLLs and the bundled vulkan-1.dll)
win-x64.build: mpv .github/workflows/build.yml job 'win32' (target x86_64-pc-windows-msvc), ci/build-win32.ps1, at the v0.41.0 commit
win-x64.notes: Chosen over mpv-v0.41.0-x86_64-w64-mingw32.zip: one static mpv.exe (FFmpeg 8.0 release branch, LuaJIT, libplacebo, d3d11, Vulkan) instead of 25 DLLs from git master. mpv.pdb (229 MB of debug symbols) and the mpv-register/unregister scripts are not extracted.

mac-arm64.publisher: mpv-player: first-party GitHub CI build attached to the v0.41.0 release
mac-arm64.minOs: macOS 14.0 (LC_BUILD_VERSION minos of mpv and its dylibs)
mac-arm64.build: mpv .github/workflows/build.yml job 'macos' (runner macos-14, arm), ci/build-macos.sh + meson target macos-bundle, Homebrew dependencies
mac-arm64.notes: Chosen over the macos-15-arm and macos-26-arm builds because it runs on the oldest macOS. The zip wraps a tarball (mpv.tar.gz) that holds mpv.app. The .gitkeep placeholders and AppleDouble (._*) files are dropped; electron-builder re-signs the bundle ad hoc.

mac-x64.publisher: mpv-player: first-party GitHub CI build attached to the v0.41.0 release
mac-x64.minOs: macOS 15.0 (mpv and 7 bundled dylibs are built for 15.0)
mac-x64.build: mpv .github/workflows/build.yml job 'macos' (runner macos-15-intel), ci/build-macos.sh + meson target macos-bundle, Homebrew dependencies
mac-x64.notes: The only Intel build mpv-player publishes. Same archive layout as mac-arm64.
